name: Keyboard shortcuts advance and go back through questions
description: On the Solstice take page, pressing a number key selects an answer and advances, and pressing the left arrow returns to the previous question — verifying documented keyboard navigation works in both directions.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Solstice take page
Press the keyboard number key '4' to select the fourth point on the answer scale
Verify the question advances so the progress indicator reads '2 of 36'.
Verify the question returns to the first question so the progress indicator reads '1 of 36', confirming keyboard navigation moves backward as well as forward.
